== Card credits ==
Aaron Nelson is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of six cards.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards are in [[Virtual Block 6]], [[Virtual Block 7]] and [[Virtual Block 8]], sets released from 2009 to 2012. The occasions named in the concept credits date from 2008 to 2012.
Six cards in all (Concept: 6).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Aaron Nelson|Aaron Nelson]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>

* "Endor Regionals 2010": [[OOM Command Battle Droid|••OOM Command Battle Droid]]
* "MPC Team Event 2010" (see [[2010 Match Play Championship]]): [[Declaration Of Rebellion|•Declaration Of Rebellion]]
* "PC Volunteer Award 2012": [[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8)|•Sonic Bombardment (V)]]
* "Player of the Year 2009": [[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent|•Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent]]
* "West Nationals 2008": [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler|•BoShek, Brash Smuggler]]
* "West Nationals 2009" (see [[2009 US West Nationals]]): [[Guild Of Assassins (V)|•Guild Of Assassins]]
